failure_summary.description: Some requested properties were routed to less-specific or mismatched validators instead of the endpoint that best matched the operation and constraints.
Distinct requested actions were left uncovered, including actions embedded in multi-part queries.
Calls omitted or mis-mapped supported filters, counts, page settings, bounds, or endpoint-specific parameter names and values.
Multiple invocations were bundled into one object, so the intended separate calls were not preserved.

patch.reasoning: These errors are already addressed by the current skill's outcome ledger, endpoint/schema eligibility rules, constraint-to-field mapping, and separate-call serialization checks. Additional edits would largely repeat existing guidance rather than patch a demonstrated gap.
